title: Eirlys Frostblade - SkyrimNet Ready Follower
tagline: Meet Eirlys Frostblade, a Nord warrior with an unyielding sense of justice and a mastery of the greatsword. Born in Winterhold amidst magic and turmoil, she pursues a path of righteousness.
description:
Eirlys is a heroic, headstrong, and protective follower who finds purpose in wielding her greatsword for justice.

Born in Winterhold, Eirlys Frostblade defied her family’s tradition of magic, embracing instead the martial path carved by her uncle. Her stern dedication to safeguarding the innocent from magical chaos has always set her apart. With strong ideals and the skill to back them, every swing of her blade reflects her unyielding loyalty to the greater good.

Personality, Dialogue and Romance
Eirlys is not swayed by flattery. She is not one for idle chit-chat, nor does she find solace in magic. Instead, she is driven by an unwavering loyalty to justice, marked by a fierce determination to protect the voiceless. Her headstrong nature and idealistic view of the world make her a formidable ally and a force against those who seek to abuse power.

Eirlys Frostblade comes with about 240 lines of dialogue from dynamic passive dialogue based on your bond to her, quest awareness, location and weather awareness, and combat dialogue. As you spend time with Eirlys Frostblade, she'll open up more about who she is and her history, ultimately unlocking a romance with her.

Growing Her Bond
With Troth, dialogue isn't the only way to increase your bond with Eirlys Frostblade. By doing activities she likes (and avoiding the ones she doesn't), your bond will grow naturally.
Likes: Creatures Killed, Undead Killed, Main Quests Completed, Side Quests Completed
Dislikes: Murders, Daedric Quests Completed

What You Get
Two-Handed Warrior archetype
3BA body
High Poly Head
A stunning visage with Aretuza Eyes Remastered, Complete Vanilla Eye Overhaul, and KS Hairdos SMP
Uses Skyforge Steel Greatsword as her weapon of choice
ESL-flagged (ESPFE) — won't take up a full plugin slot in your load order.

Combat
Eirlys Frostblade is a Two-Handed Warrior archetype — she relies on the sheer weight of a two-handed weapon, favoring Skyforge Steel Greatsword, favoring strength over subtlety.

Where to Find Her
Seek Eirlys amidst the frozen wilds near Winterhold, where she vigilantly guards against the threats that ice and magic conceal. Check The Frozen Hearth.

Optional Outfit (SPID)
Optional SPID armor/clothing file included if you'd like to use the outfit shown in the screenshots. Required: Bladedancer's Edge (CBBE - 3BA - BHUNP), 3BA, and Spell Perk Item Distributor.
About Troth
This follower runs on Troth, a shared companion bond framework required by every WinterishClover follower. Troth tracks your relationship with her over time — purely through play, no dialogue grinding or busywork required — and unlocks deeper conversation and content as your bond grows, from first meeting through to her closest tier.

Troth includes a lightweight SkyUI MCM page where you can check your current standing with her at a glance. It's a single shared framework rather than something built into each follower individually, so it only ever needs to be installed once no matter how many WinterishClover followers you're running.
